subject.title: feat(sessions): upstream liveness for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should upstream activity become a public `SessionCatalogProvider` capability now, and if so must its identity and source-kind contract support third-party plugins rather than only Claude and Codex?
rationale: This PR expands the public Plugin SDK and persistent session model; automation cannot choose the permanent extension boundary or intentionally accept a bundled-only contract.

options.title: Generalize the public seam
options.body: Carry an opaque link identity and plugin-defined source kind through the SDK, then land the bundled providers against that contract.

options.title: Keep it bundled-only
options.body: Remove the public SDK expansion and keep the Claude and Codex implementation internal until a generic contract is approved.

options.title: Defer to observer design
options.body: Pause this branch and resolve the broader SessionObserver architecture in the canonical issue before implementing the public seam.

recommendation.title: Generalize the public seam
recommendation.body: Carry an opaque link identity and plugin-defined source kind through the SDK, then land the bundled providers against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session-state foundations and canonical feature proposal are tied to this feature history.
